diagnostics.message: :data.aws_ecs_task_definition.this: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_ecs_task_definition.this is redundant — already implied by attribute references

`:data.aws_ecs_task_definition.this` has an explicit `depends_on` on `:resource.aws_ecs_task_definition.this`, but the data source's `task_definition = aws_ecs_task_definition.this[0].family` argument already establishes the identical implicit dependency (the graph records it in both `implicit_deps` and `depends_on_deps`).
